[Problem]{.card-kicker} **This Message Will Self-Destruct in 5s** [AC abc166_e · This Message Will Self-Destruct in 5s](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc166/tasks/abc166_e)

The condition mixes **indices and values**, and the move is to separate them: put everything about $i$ on one side and everything about $j$ on the other. $j - i = A_i + A_j$ becomes $i + A_i = j - A_j$. Now the pair condition is "a key computed from the left member equals a key computed from the right member" — but the two keys are **different functions** ($i + A_i$ on the left, $j - A_j$ on the right), so a plain histogram with $\binom{c}{2}$ does not apply. Fix the right end instead (@sec-cnt-a3): sweep $j$, ask how many earlier $i$ had left-key $j - A_j$, then file $j$'s own left-key $j + A_j$. One map, one pass.

[Solved in full in @sec-cnt-pidx-message.]{.card-link}

:::
